evidence: Authored execution-page observer in synthetic Windows x64 fixtures under Wine 10 Sikarugir on macOS
checks: Cold and previously executed RX functions trap before execution and return the expected authored result after restoration.
Neighbor entry on the same page wins and is identified exactly.
Sixteen concurrent callers complete with one retained capture.
Cancellation restores execution without producing a capture.
Unsupported writable protections and observer own-module pages refuse.
Queried protection is unchanged on refusal, including Wine image copy-on-write normalization.
Foreign software-raised faults are forwarded; subsequent calls preserve the recorded context.
Captured RSP stack window is readable; this is not a stack unwind.
Final protection is RX, authored function bytes are unchanged, and fixture DLL file hash is unchanged.
fixture_correction: Initial image RW refusal assertion compared the query with the requested flag. Wine reported copy-on-write. The corrected fixture records the actual pre-arm protection and requires it to remain unchanged. Observer code did not change for this correction.
limitations: No exhaustive cancellation race or restoration-failure injection.
Neighboring code can consume the one-shot capture.
Page protection changes and exception handling perturb execution timing.
No manager ownership, destruction or scheduling guarantee follows from these fixture results.
